summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2013 Acura RDX, ILX, 2012-2013 Honda CR-V, Civic, and 2013 Accord vehicles equipped with certain Takata front and passenger air bag inflators. The inflators may rupture due to propellant degradation occurring after long-term exposure to high absolute humidity and high temperature variation.
consequence: An inflator rupture may result in sharp metal fragments striking the driver or other occupants resulting in serious injury or death.
remedy: Dealers will replace the front driver or passenger air bag inflator, free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed December 18, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-888-234-2138. Honda's numbers for this recall are BQK, MQJ, KQI, and QQH. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 22, 2026.
vehicles: ACURA ILX (2013); ACURA RDX (2013); HONDA ACCORD (2013); HONDA CIVIC (2012-2013); HONDA CR-V (2012-2013)

summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Ram 1500 Classic pickup trucks. The anti-lock brake (ABS) module software may misread inputs from the brake pedal and pedal sensor, which can result in improper brake light illumination, unintentional vehicle movement, or a loss of driver assist features, such as electronic stability control, AutoPark, and forward collision warning.
consequence: Improper brake light illumination, unintentional vehicle movement, and a loss of driver assist features, such as electronic stability control, AutoPark, and forward collision warning, can increase the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will update the ABS module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 14, 2027. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is A9D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 26, 2026.

component: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain MOPAR anti-lock braking system (ABS) control modules with part numbers 68630789AA and 68630302AA. The ABS software may misread inputs from the brake pedal and pedal sensor, which can result in improper brake light illumination, unintentional vehicle movement, or a loss of driver assist features, such as electronic stability control, AutoPark, and forward collision warning.
consequence: Improper brake light illumination, unintentional vehicle movement, and a loss of driver assist features, such as electronic stability control, AutoPark, and forward collision warning, can increase the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will update the ABS module software, free of charge. Dealers will repurchase uninstalled ABS modules. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 14, 2027. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is B0D.

summary: Fire Research Corp. (FRC) has submitted a Defect Information Report based upon recall determinations made by REVO (Recall 26V649), Spartan (recall 26V654), and KME (Recall 26V657). Certain OmniPlex S-Node 22X6 modules, with part number XE-SLM226-D0B, OmniPlex S-Node 8X16 modules, with part numbers XE-SLM816-D0A, XE-SLM816-D0B, and XE-SLM816-D0C installed on emergency vehicles may become unresponsive and cause a loss of functionality of connected components, such as exterior lighting and pump-mode.
consequence: A loss of exterior lights can reduce the visibility of the vehicle to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash. A loss of pump-mode function may prevent or delay the use of emergency equipment, increasing the risk of injury.
remedy: Affected vehicle manufacturers will determine the appropriate remedy for their vehicles. Vehicle owners may contact the respective vehicle manufacturers customer service phone numbers listed in each vehicle manufacturer recall.
vehicles: Fire Research Corp. OmniPlex S-Node 22x6; Fire Research Corp. OmniPlex S-Node 8x16

component: SUSPENSION:REAR:SPRINGS:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY:U-BOLT, LEAF SPRING TO AXLE
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2024-2026 AT Series vehicles. The U-bolt securing the rear suspension may not have been properly tightened after rear suspension modification work was completed.
consequence: An incorrectly tightened U-bolt may loosen and allow the rear axle to loosen or detach, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Altec will instruct owners to inspect the suspension for loose U-bolts. Depending on the inspection results, the U-bolts will be tightened or replaced as necessary. If any damage is found, the suspension will be repaired or replaced at an Altec service center. Repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 8, 2027. Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3386.

summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2025-2026 AM Series Aerial Device, and AN Series Aerial Device vehicles. The activation handle for the platform stow valve at the lower controls may have been assembled without thread locking compound, and can loosen and separate from the control valve.
consequence: A separated activation handle can allow the control valve to eject hot oil, increasing the risk of injury.
remedy: Altec will instruct owners to inspect the platform rotate valve for an affected lot number. If the valve is from the affected lot, owners can order a kit and replace the affected valve or schedule service with Altec, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 8, 2027. Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3385.
vehicles: ALTEC AM SERIES AERIAL DEVICE (2025-2026); ALTEC AN SERIES AERIAL DEVICE (2025-2026)

component: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:HARD PARTS INTERNAL/MECHANICAL
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2023 and 2025-2026 Tundra vehicles. One of the engine camshafts may have been manufactured incorrectly, allowing cracks to develop that can cause the camshaft to snap, possibly leading to an engine stall and loss of drive power.
consequence: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the camshaft as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed beginning December 28, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB26 and 26TA26.

summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2004-2005 S2000 vehicles. The fuel flange joint assembly may have been improperly manufactured, allowing the fuel line connection to loosen and separate and possibly causing a fuel leak and engine stall.
consequence: An engine stall while driving increases the risk of a crash or injury.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the fuel flange joint assembly, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 4, 2027. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-866-784-1870. Honda's number for this recall is LQD. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 20, 2026.

summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2002-2010 Lexus SC430, 2011 IS250, 2017 GX460, 2003-2008 Toyota Corolla, 2005-2006 Tundra, 2005-2007 Sequoia, and 2016-2017 4Runner vehicles equipped with certain Takata front passenger air bag inflators installed as original equipment or as replacement parts under a prior recall. The inflators may rupture due to propellant degradation occurring after long-term exposure to high absolute humidity, high temperatures, and high temperature cycling.
consequence: An inflator rupture may result in sharp metal fragments striking the driver or other occupants resulting in serious injury or death.
remedy: Depending on the vehicle model, dealers will replace the front passenger air bag inflator or the air bag assembly, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed beginning December 28, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB25, 26TA25, 26LB11, and 26LA11.
vehicles: LEXUS GX (2017); LEXUS IS (2011); LEXUS SC (2002-2010); TOYOTA 4RUNNER (2016-2017); TOYOTA COROLLA (2003-2008); TOYOTA SEQUOIA (2005-2007); TOYOTA TUNDRA (2005-2006)

summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2027 Anthem AN (4), Pioneer PR (4), Pinnacle (PI/PN), Granite (GR), TerraPro (TE), and LR vehicles. The driveline may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, possibly causing the driveline to separate from the vehicle.
consequence: A driveline separation can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash. Detached components can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the driveline as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 11, 2027. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0503. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 19, 2026.
vehicles: MACK ANTHEM AN (4) (2027); MACK GRANITE (GR) (2027); MACK LR (2027); MACK PINNACLE (PI/PN) (2027); MACK PIONEER PR (4) (2027); MACK TERRAPRO (TE) (2027)

summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2027 VNL (4), VNR (4), and VN vehicles. The driveline may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, possibly causing the driveline to separate from the vehicle.
consequence: A driveline separation can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash. Detached components can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the driveline as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 11, 2027. Owners may contact Volvo Trucks' customer service at 800-528-6586. Volvo Trucks' number for this recall is RVXX2614. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 19, 2026.
vehicles: VOLVO VN (2027); VOLVO VNL (4) (2027); VOLVO VNR (4) (2027)

summary: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2026 Thrive travel trailers. The original Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) and Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) were not listed the certification label after vehicle alterations. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
consequence: If the values of the GVWR and GAWR differ from the original label values, it can lead to unintentionally overloading the trailer, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Winnebago will provide corrected labels, free of charge. Owner letters are expected to be mailed January 7, 2027. Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-574-825-5280 Ext. 5220. Winnebago's number for this recall is 44448365.

summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain Meritor drivelines with model number RPL20 and with part numbers 20RHS004B029, 20RHM085B180, 20RHS005F021, and 20RHS004E049. The driveline may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, possibly causing the driveline to separate from the vehicle.
consequence: A driveline separation can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash. Detached components can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the driveline as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 11, 2027. Owners may contact Volvo Trucks' customer service at 800-528-6586. Volvo Trucks' number for this recall is RVXX2615.

summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain Meritor drivelines with model number RPL20 and with part numbers 20RHS004B029, 20RHM085B180, 20RHS005F021, and 20RHS004E049. The driveline may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, possibly causing the driveline to separate from the vehicle.
consequence: A driveline separation can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash. Detached components can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the driveline as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 11, 2027. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0504.

component: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: SENSING SYSTEM: RADAR
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2027 Kenworth T680, T880, W990, Peterbilt 567, 579, and 589 vehicles. The forward-looking radar may falsely detect stationary or slow-moving objects in the left lane as relevant vehicles, which may cause unintended braking.
consequence: Unintended braking increases the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will update the radar software, free of charge. Owner letters are expected to be mailed January 10, 2026. Owners may contact Peterbilt's customer service at 1-940-591-4220 or Kenworth's customer service at 1-425-828-5888. PACCAR's number for this recall is 26PACL. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning January 10, 2027.
vehicles: KENWORTH T680 (2027); KENWORTH T880 (2027); KENWORTH W990 (2027); PETERBILT 567 (2027); PETERBILT 579 (2027); PETERBILT 589 (2027)

summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2027 Kenworth T280, T380, T680, T880, and W990 vehicles. The drivelines may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, causing the bearing cup to separate from the driveline.
consequence: A driveline separation can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash. Detached components can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the driveline as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 10, 2027. Owners may contact Kenworth's customer service at 1-425-828-5888. PACCAR's number for this recall is 26PACK. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on January 10, 2027.
vehicles: KENWORTH T280 (2027); KENWORTH T380 (2027); KENWORTH T680 (2027); KENWORTH T880 (2027); KENWORTH W990 (2027)

component: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:ABS WARNING LIGHT
summary: Indian Motorcycle Company (Indian) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Chief and Chief Bobber motorcycles. The ABS warning light on the analog speedometer may fail to illuminate during an ABS fault or ABS event. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 122, "Motorcycle Brake Systems."
consequence: Failure of the ABS warning light to notify the rider of a disabled system can result in a loss of stability, increasing the risk of injury.
remedy: Dealers will update the gauge software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 9, 2026. Owners may contact Indian customer service at 877-204-3697. Indian's number for this recall is I-26-03. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 20, 2026.

summary: Hendrickson USA. L.L.C. (Hendrickson) is recalling certain STEERTEK NXT front steer axle assemblies. The huck collars may not have been properly connected to the mating pins.
consequence: The huck pins may come loose and become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Hendrickson will work the affected vehicle manufacturers to inspect and replace the axle assemblies as necessary, free of charge. Hendrickson will notify all affected vehicle manufacturers. Owners may contact Hendrickson customer service at 1-630-910-2800 or 1-855-743-3733. Hendrickson's number for this recall is HTRUCK 2026-01.

component: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
summary: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2021-2026-XD40, 2022-2026 XD35, 2023-2024 XDE60, and 2023-2026 XD60 transit buses. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
remedy: Cummins will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owners may contact Cummins' customer service at 1-800-286-6467 or New Flyer's customer service at 1-800-241-2947, ext. 2.
vehicles: NEW FLYER XD35 (2022-2026); NEW FLYER XD40 (2021-2026); NEW FLYER XD60 (2023-2026); NEW FLYER XDE60 (2023-2024)

summary: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2021-2026 Commander, Warrior, and 2021, 2024-2025 Avenger emergency vehicles equipped with a Bussmann mini fuse box. The fuse box may not have the correct amperage capacity, causing it to overheat.
consequence: An overheated fuse box can melt, increasing the risk of a fire.
remedy: Dealers will reroute large amp draws to a separate fuse bank, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 9, 2026. Owners may contact Rosenbauer customer service at 1-651-462-1000.
vehicles: ROSENBAUER AVENGER (2021, 2024-2025); ROSENBAUER COMMANDER (2021-2026); ROSENBAUER WARRIOR (2021-2026)

summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2017, 2020-2026 Utilimaster Upfit vehicles. The tire and loading label may not list the combined weight value. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard Number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
consequence: Missing information may lead to unintentionally overloading the tires, increasing the risk of tire failure and a crash.
remedy: Shyft will supply new labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 4, 2026. Owners may contact Shyft customer service at 1-800-237-7806. Shyft's number for this recall is 26-08.

summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2025-2026 AN Series, AA Series, and AM Series Aerial Device vehicles. The retention hardware for the rear mounting pin on the jib tilt cylinder may be improperly tightened.
consequence: Loose hardware can fall out and release the cylinder pin, causing the jib to swing freely and the winch line to drop up to 10 feet, which increases the risk of injury.
remedy: Altec will provide instructions on how to inspect and properly tighten the retention hardware, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 4, 2027. Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3381.
vehicles: ALTEC AA SERIES AERIAL DEVICE (2025-2026); ALTEC AM SERIES AERIAL DEVICE (2025-2026); ALTEC AN SERIES AERIAL DEVICE (2025-2026)

summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2027 Western Star 49X, Western Star 47X, Freightliner Cascadia Fifth Gen, Freightliner Cascadia, Freightliner 114SD, Freightliner Business Class M2, and Freightliner 108SD vehicles equipped with certain Cummins drivelines. The driveline may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, possibly causing the driveline to separate from the vehicle.
consequence: Driveline separation can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash. Detached components can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Cummins will inspect and replace the driveline as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 5, 2027. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712 or Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467. DTNA's number for this recall is F1046.
vehicles: FREIGHTLINER 108SD (2027); FREIGHTLINER 114SD (2027); FREIGHTLINER BUSINESS CLASS M2 (2027); FREIGHTLINER CASCADIA (2027); FREIGHTLINER CASCADIA FIFTH GEN (2027); WESTERN STAR 47X (2027); WESTERN STAR 49X (2027)

summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2020 Western Star 4900, 2024 Freightliner Cascadia, and 2027 Western Star 49X vehicles. The Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) listed on the Federal Certification Label is incorrect, which can allow the vehicle to be overloaded. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
consequence: An overloaded vehicle can increase the risk of a crash.
remedy: The remedy is currently under development. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 5, 2027. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712. DTNA's number for this recall is F1045.
vehicles: FREIGHTLINER CASCADIA (2024); WESTERN STAR 4900 (2020); WESTERN STAR 49X (2027)

component: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
summary: Acura (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 Acura ZDX vehicles equipped with all-wheel drive. A software error may unexpectedly activate the anti-lock brake system (ABS) and release brake pressure.
consequence: A loss of brake pressure may reduce braking ability, extending the distance needed to stop and increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: The electronic brake control module software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Acura customer service at 1-800-382-2238. Acura's number for this recall is CQC. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 24V614.

summary: Lamar Trailers, Inc (Lamar Trailers) is recalling certain 2021-2027 gooseneck trailers. The spare tire may be improperly secured, allowing the spare tire to detach.
consequence: A detached tire can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will replace the mounting hardware, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 4, 2027. Owners may contact Lamar Trailers' customer service at 903-782-9333.

summary: Yokohama Tire Corporation (Yokohama) is recalling certain Geolandar M/T G003 tires, sizes LT285/70R17 and LT245/75R16. The tires may have been manufactured improperly, which can cause tire sidewall separation, air leakage or rapid air loss.
consequence: A rapid loss of tire air pressure can cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will replace the tires, free of charge. Owners may contact Yokohama's Consumer Affairs at 1-800-423-4544.

summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2012-2016 3 Series, 5 Series, Z4, 2012-2015 X1, 2013-2017 X3, 2015-2016 4 Series Gran Coupe, 2 Series Convertible, 2014-2016 328xi Gran Turismo, 2 Series Coupe, 4 Series Convertible, 3 Series Coupe, 3 Series Sportswagon, 2015-2018 X4, and 2016-2018 X5 xDrive40e vehicles. An improperly sealed electrical connector on the water pump may be exposed to water and short circuit.
consequence: A short circuit increases the risk of a fire.
remedy: Owners are advised to park their vehicles outside and away from structures until the recall remedy is completed. The remedy is currently under development. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed in December 2026. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning December 25, 2026. This recall replaces NHTSA recall number 24V608. Vehicles already repaired under the previous recall will need to have the new remedy completed.

summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2027 Atlas vehicles. The second-row center seat ISOFIX/LATCH child seat anchor openings may be partially obstructed by surrounding stitching, preventing a child seat from being properly secured. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."
consequence: A child seat that is not secured properly can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
remedy: Owners are advised not to use the second-row center seat to secure a child restraint system using the ISOFIX/LATCH anchorages until the remedy is completed. Dealers will repair the seams around the child seat anchor openings, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to mail January 3, 2027. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 74iF. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 10, 2026.

summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2027 i7 50xDrive, i7 60xDrive, 2026-2027 i5 xDrive40, i5 eDrive40, and i5 M60 vehicles. The high voltage battery charging software may be incorrect.
consequence: Software that does not charge the battery properly can lead to electric shock, increasing the risk of injury.
remedy: Dealers will update the high voltage battery charging software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 25, 2026. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning December 25, 2026.
vehicles: BMW I5 EDRIVE40 (2026-2027); BMW I5 M60 XDRIVE (2026-2027); BMW I5 XDRIVE40 (2026-2027); BMW I7 XDRIVE50 (2027); BMW I7 XDRIVE60 (2027)

component: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM)
summary: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain 2026 FLHXLSE, FLTRXSTSE, FLHXSTSE, FLHXSE, FLHXL, FLTRXP, FLTRX, FLTRXL, and FLHX motorcycles. The engine control module (ECM) may communicate the incorrect gear position of neutral when the transmission is actually in gear.
consequence: The motorcycle can experience unintended forward motion, increasing the risk of an injury.
remedy: Dealers will replace the gear position sensor, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 16, 2026. Owners may contact Harley-Davidson customer service at 1-800-258-2464. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became became searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 6, 2025. Harley-Davidson's number for this recall is 0194.
vehicles: HARLEY-DAVIDSON FLHX (2026); HARLEY-DAVIDSON FLHXL (2026); HARLEY-DAVIDSON FLHXLSE (2026); HARLEY-DAVIDSON FLHXSE (2026); HARLEY-DAVIDSON FLHXSTSE (2026); HARLEY-DAVIDSON FLTRX (2026); HARLEY-DAVIDSON FLTRXL (2026); HARLEY-DAVIDSON FLTRXP (2026); HARLEY-DAVIDSON FLTRXSTSE (2026)

summary: Spencer Manufacturing, Inc. (Spencer) is recalling certain 2026 Rescue, 2025 Initial Attack, and 2024-2025 Pumper emergency vehicles. The display may stop responding to touch commands or fail to power on, preventing the activation of exterior emergency lights, fire fighting and other emergency equipment.
consequence: A loss of exterior lights can reduce the visibility of the vehicle to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash. Inoperative equipment can delay emergency response, increasing the risk of injury.
remedy: Spencer will work with Hale Products to update the firmware and install a monitor system, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 21, 2026. Owners may contact customer service at 1-269-637-8721.
vehicles: SPENCER INITIAL ATTACK (2025); SPENCER PUMPER (2024-2025); SPENCER RESCUE (2026)

component: AIR BAGS: AIR BAG/RESTRAINT CONTROL MODULE:SOFTWARE
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Veloster N, 2019-2023 Kona Electric vehicles. A software error in the air bag control unit (ACU) may improperly deactivate the air bag system and seat belt pretensioners.
consequence: Air bags and seat belt pretensioners that do not activate in a crash increases the risk of injury.
remedy: Dealers will update the ACU software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 1, 2027. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 311. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 6, 2026.
vehicles: HYUNDAI KONA ELECTRIC (2019-2023); HYUNDAI VELOSTER N (2019-2022)

summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Transit vehicles. A software error in the body control module C (BCMC) may cause the module to freeze, shutting off certain features such as interior lighting and trailer lights. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
consequence: A loss of lighting can reduce trailer visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: The body control module C (BCMC) software will be updated by a dealer, or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed November 16, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26C49. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 6, 2026.

summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Explorer Police Interceptor vehicles. A phantom "Global On" command in the overhead console may illuminate the map lights and prevent them from being turned off. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) Number 101, "Controls and Displays."
consequence: Overhead map lights that illuminate unintentionally and cannot be turned off may distract the driver or cause interior glare, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will replace the overhead consoles on vehicles built prior to July 9, 2026. consequence: A loss of warning lights can increase the risk of a crash.

summary: Kalmar Solutions, LLC (Kalmar) is recalling certain 2014-2026 Ottawa T2 4X2 and 2016-2026 T2 6X4 DOT/EPA terminal tractors. The printed circuit board (PCB) insulation may become damaged, resulting in a short circuit.
consequence: A short circuit increases the risk of a fire even when the vehicle is parked and the ignition is in the 'Off' position.
remedy: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until their vehicle is repaired. Kalmar will rewire the cabin power and add a 5A fuse to the PCB circuit, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed by December 4, 2026. Owners may contact Kalmar customer service at 1-888-229-6300, select option 4, then option 2.

summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2027 Surveyor recreational trailers. The exterior receptacle may not be wired to a GFCI circuit.
consequence: An outlet without GFCI protection may fail to shut off electrical power when a ground-fault occurs, increasing the risk of injury.
remedy: Dealers will rewire the exterior outlet, free of charge. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-642-3119. Forest River's number for this recall is 37-2103.

summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Sunseeker, Solera, and Forester recreational vehicles. The Federal Placard may have incorrect tire inflation listed.
consequence: A tire can be overinflated after referencing the incorrect information, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will replace the labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 30, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-206-7600. Forest River's number for this recall is 34-2102.
vehicles: FOREST RIVER FORESTER (2026-2027); FOREST RIVER SOLERA (2026-2027); FOREST RIVER SUNSEEKER (2026-2027)

summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 2018-2026 buses. Please see the complete list of models above. The instrument panel indicator light may not illuminate when the hazard warning lights are on and the master run switch is in the 'Off' position. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
consequence: Without the illuminated reminder, the driver may fail to turn off the exterior lights when no longer needed. Hazard warning lights that remain activated unintentionally can confuse other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: MCI will update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 24, 2026. Owners may contact MCI customer service at 1-800-241-2947.

consequence: Without the illuminated reminder, the driver may fail to turn off the exterior lights when no longer needed. Hazard warning lights that remain activated unintentionally can confuse other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.

summary: Greenpower Motor Company Inc. (Greenpower) is recalling certain 2021 Nano Beast school buses. A control module interlock software error may allow the bus to move while the wheelchair lift is deployed.
consequence: The bus moving while the wheelchair lift is in use increases the risk of injury.
remedy: Dealers will update the control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 12, 2026. Owners may contact Greenpower's customer service at 1-909-346-1090. Greenpower's number for this recall is GP2604002.

summary: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2022-2024 All American Electric transit buses. The high voltage battery system mounting bolts may be loose or missing.
consequence: A high voltage battery with loose or missing mounting bolts can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and reinstall bolts with thread locker. Damaged or missing bolts will be replaced. All repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 1, 2026. Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242. Blue Bird's number for this recall is R26AK.
vehicles: BLUE BIRD ALL AMERICAN TRANSIT BUS (ELECTRIC) (2022-2024)

consequence: A high voltage battery with loose or missing mounting bolts can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and reinstall bolts with thread locker. Damaged or missing bolts will be replaced. All repairs will be performed free of charge. summary: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Commander and 2024 Warrior fire engines. The rim weld may crack, causing the wheel to separate and tire to deflate.
consequence: Wheel and/or tire failure increases the risk of a crash.
remedy: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until the remedy has been completed. Dealers will replace the wheels and tires as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 19, 2026. Owners may contact Rosenbauer customer service at 1-651-462-1000.

summary: Ring Power Corporation (Ring Power) is recalling certain 2020 Terex General 65, 2020-2021 C6000, 2020-2022 C4000, and TC55 vehicles. The incorrect pintle hitch may have been installed without reinforced bracing, resulting in the rear bumper hitch plate bending.
consequence: The pintle hitch may fail, causing a loss of trailer control and increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Ring Power will inspect, replace the pintle hitch, and install bracing. Damaged bumpers will be replaced. All repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 16, 2026. Owners may contact Ring Power's customer service at 904-613-0035. Ring Power's number for this recall is 23402.

summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2025 S 500 4MATIC, Maybach S 580 4MATIC, Maybach S 680 4MATIC, S 580 4MATIC, and 2023-2025 S 580 E 4MATIC vehicles. The front brake hoses may rupture and leak brake fluid.
consequence: A brake fluid leak can extend the distance needed to stop the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will replace the front brake hoses, free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed November 20, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 25V116. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 9, 2026.
vehicles: MERCEDES-BENZ AMG S 63 E 4MATIC+ (2024-2025); MERCEDES-BENZ S 500 4MATIC (2022-2025); MERCEDES-BENZ S 580 4MATIC (2022-2025); MERCEDES-BENZ S 580 E 4MATIC (2023-2025); MERCEDES-MAYBACH S 580 4MATIC (2022-2025); MERCEDES-MAYBACH S 680 4MATIC (2022-2025)

summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2020-2026 AA Series Aerial Device, 2021-2026 AN Series Aerial Device, 2023-2026 AM Series Aerial Device, and 2024-2026 Digger Derrick, and 2024-2025 A-Class vehicles. The turntable mounted platform access step may have been improperly welded between the step tube and mounting plate, and allow the step to separate from the vehicle.
consequence: A step that separates or becomes unstable while in use, increases the risk of a fall or injury.
remedy: Altec will replace the steps, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Owners may contact Altec's customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3374.

summary: Mercedes-Benz is recalling certain 2027 CLA 220 vehicles. A component of the left front seat belt may have been installed incorrectly.
consequence: A seat belt with an incorrectly installed component may fail to properly restrain occupants, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the seat belt as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.

summary: Daimler Trucks North America (DTNA) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Freightliner Business Class M2 vehicles. The underbody insulation may contact hot exhaust components.
consequence: Insulation that comes into contact with hot exhaust components increases the risk of a fire.
remedy: The remedy is currently under development. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712. DTNA's number for this recall is F1041.

summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2023-2025 VT1300CX and 2024-2025 VT750 motorcycles. The fuel pump may malfunction due to a manufacturing defect.
consequence: Fuel pump failure can cause an engine stall, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will replace the fuel pump, free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available, anticipated in January 2027. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-866-784-1870. vehicles: HONDA SHADOW PHANTOM (2024-2025); HONDA VT1300CX FURY (2023-2025)

summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2027 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER C2 and Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER C2 Jouley school buses. A software error may cause the low beam headlights to illuminate improperly.
consequence: Insufficient low beam headlight illumination can reduce driver visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the headlights, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed November 12, 2026. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712. DTNA's number for this recall is F1040.
vehicles: THOMAS BUILT BUSES SAF-T-LINER C2 (2027); THOMAS BUILT BUSES SAF-T-LINER C2 JOULEY (2027)

summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Anthem AN (4) and 2025-2027 Pioneer PR (4) vehicles. The intake and grille bezels may detach from the vehicle.
consequence: A detached bezel can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect, replace the intake and grille bezels, and install cable ties as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0501. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 8, 2026.
vehicles: MACK ANTHEM AN (4) (2026-2027); MACK PIONEER PR (4) (2025-2027)

summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2023-2026 ID.4 vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail and lead to a vehicle fire.
consequence: A vehicle fire increases the risk of injury.
remedy: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% battery capacity until the repair has been completed. The remedy is currently under development. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 93EX. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

vehicles: GREENPOWER EV STAR BUS (2018-2024); GREENPOWER EV STAR MOBILITY PLUS BUS (2020-2023)

summary: Grech Motors Inc. (Grech) is recalling certain 2027 Strada, Terreno, and 2026-2027 Turismo motorhomes equipped with certain MaxxAir N-Series Maxxfan rooftop ventilation fans. The printed circuit board may fail during certain operations and overheat.
consequence: An overheated printed circuit board increases the risk of a fire.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the printed circuit board as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 30, 2026. Owners may contact Grech Customer service at 1-951-688-8347.

summary: Highland Ridge RV (Highland Ridge) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Range Lite Air travel trailers. The fasteners may fail, causing the fresh water tank to detach.
consequence: A detached tank can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will redrill holes and install new screws and bolts, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 6, 2026. Owners may contact Highland Ridge customer service at 1-800-283-8267. Highland Ridge's number for this recall is 9904669.

summary: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2027 R2 vehicles. A high voltage battery fastener may have been improperly tightened, causing a loss of drive power.
consequence: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
remedy: Rivian will inspect and repair the connection or replace damaged components as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 30, 2026. Owners may contact Rivian customer service at 1-888-748-4261. Rivian's number for this recall is FSAM-1888. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 28, 2026.

summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2023 LFS transit buses. The mounting screws may be too short, stripping the threads and causing the bike rack to detach.
consequence: A detached bike rack can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Nova Bus will replace the mounting screws, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 28, 2026. Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-800-350-6682. Nova Bus's number for this recall is CR5957.

summary: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Ram 1500 vehicles. The tire pressure monitoring system sensors may fail to detect low tire pressure and/or fail to illuminate the tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) warning light as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring System."
consequence: A TPMS warning light that fails to notify the driver of low tire pressure increases the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the tire pressure sensors, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 27, 2026. Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403. FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 51D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Ram 1500 vehicles. A connector for the driver and front passenger side air bags may not be secured properly, which can cause the air bags not to deploy as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection" and 214, "Side Impact Protection."
consequence: A side air bag that does not deploy as intended increases the risk of injury in a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and repair the sensor connections, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 27, 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 94D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Ram 1500 Promaster, Ram 2500 Promaster, Ram 3500 Promaster, and 2024-2026 Ram 3500 Electric (EV) vehicles. Water may enter the electric power steering wiring harness, which can disable power steering assist.
consequence: A loss of power steering assist can increase the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect, repair and replace the wiring harness and electronic power steering gear, as necessary, free of charge. Interim notification letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 17, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available, anticipated January 2027. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 92D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain MOPAR body and jumper wiring harnesses. Please refer to Chrysler's attached document for specific part number information. Water may enter the electric power steering wiring harness, which can disable power steering assist.
consequence: A loss of power steering assist can increase the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect, repair, and replace the wiring harness and electronic power steering gear, as necessary, free of charge. Dealers will repurchase uninstalled wiring harnesses. Interim notification letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 17, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available, anticipated January 2027. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 93D.

summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Anthem AN (4) and Pioneer PR (4) vehicles equipped with a tanker application package. Inaccurate axle load calculations may cause reduced braking performance while transporting smoothbore tanker trailers.
consequence: Reduced braking performance can require a greater distance to stop, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will install new software to disable the dynamic trailer braking calculations, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 29, 2026. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0500. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 5, 2026.
vehicles: MACK ANTHEM AN (4) (2026-2027); MACK PIONEER PR (4) (2026-2027)

consequence: Reduced braking performance can require a greater distance to stop, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will install new software to disable the dynamic trailer braking calculations, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 29, 2026. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 5, 2026.

summary: Cummins, Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain L9 diesel engines, part number D563027BX03. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters notifying owners of the defect are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467. Cummins number for this recall is C7311. Engines remedied under Recalls 23E055, 24E038, or 25E004 will need to have the new redesigned parts installed.

summary: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2024-2026 RM900 and 2026 RM700 trailers. The coupler mounting bolts may loosen, separating the coupler from the trailer.
consequence: A separated trailer coupler can cause a loss of control and increase the risk of a crash.
remedy: ATC will install a gusset reinforcement kit, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 13, 2026. Owners may call ATC customer service at 1-877-441-2440.

summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2021-2026 Altec Digger Derrick, and 2023-2025 Altec TA Series Aerial Device vehicles. Improper wiring may prevent the boom stow auto-neutral feature from engaging, which can allow the truck to be driven while the boom is still elevated.
consequence: When the vehicle is moved or driven with the boom out of stow, the vehicle could exceed the recorded travel height, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Altec will correct the wiring in the power distribution module to enable the boom stow auto-neutral functionality, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Owners may contact Altec's customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3370.
vehicles: ALTEC DIGGER DERRICK (2021-2026); ALTEC TA SERIES AERIAL DEVICE (2023-2025)

summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2024-2027 Reflection fifth wheel recreational trailers. The auto detect solar controller may select a 24 volt output when the electrical system is designed for 12 volts. The incorrect voltage may damage the 7-way bulkhead power center and other circuits.
consequence: While damage to the power center increases the risk of a fire, damage to the electrical system may cause the trailer brakes or exterior lightings to fail, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: An over-the-air (OTA) software update will be released. Lighting will be inspected and repaired as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 16, 2026. Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679. Grand Design's number for this recall is 910068.

summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2024 Land Rover Defender vehicles. The second-row seat belt may be improperly stitched.
consequence: An improperly stitched seat belt may fail to properly restrain an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
remedy: Dealers will inspect the second-row seat belt serial number, and replace the seat belt, as necessary, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed November 11, 2026. Owners may contact Land Rover's customer service at 800-637-6837. Land Rover's number for this recall is D130.

manufacturer: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Range Rover Sport vehicles. Cracks may develop in the rear subframe.
consequence: A cracked subframe may have reduced structural integrity, increasing the risk of injury during a crash. A crack may also diminish handling and control, increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the rear subframe as necessary, free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Land Rover customer service at 1-800-637-6837. Land Rover's numbers for this recall are D165 and D166.

summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Cadillac OPTIQ vehicles. When closed using the key fob's express-up function, the front windows may fail to detect an obstruction and reverse direction. As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."
consequence: A closing window that does not reverse direction as expected can pinch a passenger before retracting, increasing the risk of injury.
remedy: The body control module (BCM) software will be updated by a dealer or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 21, 2026.
